name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for aerodynamics, triggered by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. After completing his engineering degree at the Polytechnic University of Catalonia, he landed an internship at a small racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for wind tunnel operations. He honed his skills there for several years, mastering the intricacies of data acquisition and interpretation. 

Ricardo is a dedicated and detail-oriented professional, known for his methodical approach to problem-solving. He thrives in collaborative environments, readily sharing his knowledge and insights with colleagues. His ability to identify subtle airflow anomalies and their impact on vehicle performance sets him apart, making him a valuable asset to the ALL-INKL.COM Münnich Motorsport team. He believes in continuous learning, always seeking new ways to optimize aerodynamic efficiency.

Ricardo's reputation for precision and his calm demeanor under pressure have earned him the respect of his peers. His commitment extends beyond the technical aspects, as he deeply cares about the team's overall success and fostering a positive work environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a stocky build, often seen wearing safety glasses.
